purpose: Execute proof gates with per-gate logs and structured reports so local strict failures are debuggable and evidence collection has a stable input.

sandbox.description: Runs sandbox-safe commands, marks external-tool gates as source_only, and writes local proof evidence without claiming professional readiness.

strict.description: Runs strict proof commands, blocks when required tools are unavailable, and can only pass when every gate is real-execution proof.

runner_rules: Every gate writes stdout and stderr tails into JSON and full output into a log file.
Sandbox source_only gates are allowed only for source-checked-testnet claims.
Strict profile treats missing external tools as blocked, not pass.
A failed gate keeps its remediation text from the proof manifest visible in the report.
The runner never hides command failures behind aggregate success.
phase1_3_exit_criteria: Sandbox local proof can run and write reports/local_proof_run_report.json.
Per-gate JSON/log paths are present in the report.
Strict blockers are classed as blocked/fail/source_only with remediation guidance.
make v0393-check passes in sandbox/source mode.
